mentions.name: Selene Software Inventory
mentions.description: An open-source inventory management system designed to handle multiple stores, each with its own inventory and products. Products are organized into categories and sub-categories, with location management for each item. It was intended as the base for online stores and a brick-and-mortar shop, and development is ongoing.
mentions.problem: The author couldn't find an open-source inventory management system they liked.
mentions.source_excerpt: I couldn't find an open-source inventory management system I liked, so I started working on one.  It was designed to handle multiple stores, each with their own inventory and products.  Each product in categories and sub-categories, and location management for each item.
